dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Bulma is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. During intake, Bulma escalated to hard barking, growling, and lunging toward staff. In the prior home, Bulma was reported to be reactive toward other dogs and small animals, displaying hard barking, growling, and lunging that were difficult to redirect, and she has continued to display these reactive behaviors in the care center, including hard barking, growling, and lunging toward other dogs. Bulma participates in weekly training sessions to address and improve her reactivity. During sessions, she practices the 1-2-3 game and engage and disengage training. According to her previous owners, Bulma is friendly and outgoing with children. Medically, Bulma has Dental Disease, a Fractured Tooth, and Mammary Tumors.
